mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movie (movie_id, title, poster_url, genres_json, rating, duration_min, release_date, status, description, cast_text, want_see_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{movie.movieId}, #{movie.title}, #{movie.posterUrl}, CAST(#{movie.genresJson} AS jsonb), #{movie.rating}, #{movie.durationMin}, #{movie.releaseDate}, #{movie.status}, #{movie.description}, #{movie.castText}, #{movie.wantSeeCount}, NOW(), NOW())

mapper.update: UPDATE movie SET title = #{movie.title}, poster_url = #{movie.posterUrl}, genres_json = CAST(#{movie.genresJson} AS jsonb), rating = #{movie.rating}, duration_min = #{movie.durationMin}, release_date = #{movie.releaseDate}, status = #{movie.status}, description = #{movie.description}, cast_text = #{movie.castText}, want_see_count = #{movie.wantSeeCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE movie_id = #{movie.movieId}
